repeat with aWindow in windowsList set tabsList to every tab of aWindow set tabCount to count of tabsList repeat with i from tabCount to 1 by -1 set aTab to item i of tabsList if (URL of aTab) is equal to "$localFilePath" then set foundTab to true tell aTab to reload
-- Ensure the window is not minimized using System Events tell application "System Events" to tell process "$appProcess" set frontmost to true if value of attribute "AXMinimized" of (first window whose subrole is "AXStandardWindow") is true then click (first button of (first window whose subrole is "AXStandardWindow") whose role description is "minimize button") end if end tell
-- Bring the window to the front set index of aWindow to 1 -- Activate the tab set active tab index of aWindow to i return end if end repeat end repeat

-- Ensure the window is not minimized using System Events tell application "System Events" to tell process "$appProcess" set frontmost to true if value of attribute "AXMinimized" of (first window whose subrole is "AXStandardWindow") is true then click (first button of (first window whose subrole is "AXStandardWindow") whose role description is "minimize button") end if end tell

Check out the [README](https://github.com/yohasebe/openai-chat-api-workflow) on the GitHub repository of this workflow.
